notes:
PAGE-FACE CANDIDATE: 'J. Lane Henderson', Democrat, Office Seeking 'County Commissioner' (NO SEAT LETTER PRINTED) - index.csv names NO candidate and takes 'County Commission Seat A' from the channel's directory path; the seat is not inferred here. Filing 3 of THREE in the 2010 cycle. 9 pages, each classified from its own printed header: p1 cover ('30 Days after the General Election' checked; signed 12-1-10; clerk stamp 'DEC 2 AM 8:06'), p2 SUMMARY PAGE, pp3-6 Schedule A, pp7-9 Schedule B.

THE FLAGGED OFF-CYCLE YEAR TOKENS ('2065', '2017', '2012') ARE OCR NOISE — I read every page and there is NO bound-in prior report and no off-cycle date anywhere on this document. Every page is a 2010 form for a 2010 cycle: the cover, both summary date boxes and all seven schedule-page 'Date of Report' boxes read 12-1-10 (written '12/1/10' on the schedule pages), and every one of the 89 transcribed row dates ends in '-10'. The likeliest sources of the OCR tokens are the four-digit ZIP-adjacent strings the filer writes across this ledger (84660 / 84653 / 84663 / 84664) and the raised-cent amount forms ('2000.00', '2550.00', '1000.00'), several of which sit beside struck-out ink; two cells ARE genuinely amended and are recorded as such (p3 rows 14-17 hold a stray leading '6' before an overwritten date; p7 row 3's date is over-inked and left BLANK with needs_review=1). No year was filled in from the report date anywhere, and no date was imported from a sibling filing.

THE STRUCTURAL FINDING (identical to this filer's 10/26 report, and the reason both sides are 'cumulative-exact'): HE RE-FILES HIS ENTIRE CYCLE LEDGER EACH PERIOD. pp3-5 and pp7-8 are literal re-faxes of sheets already filed on 6/15 and 10/26 — same rows, same page subtotals — and this period's activity is TWO handwritten lines added to the existing sheets: a 2,000.00 candidate loan on p6 row 12 and a 2,550.00 billboard payment on p9 row 8, matching Column A exactly on each side. Downstream consequence for the coordinator: this record's rows 1-61 (contributions) and 1-26 (expenditures) are the SAME EVENTS as those on records b2b16869 and 54467fcc; the county published the same ledger three times. A candidate-cycle total must not add the three filings' rows together — on this filer the cycle total is simply this report's 25,469.07 / 25,866.52.

THE COVER CHAIN HOLDS: line 3 'Balance at Beginning' prints 869.22, exactly the 10/26 report's printed line 7 close, and line 5 - line 6 = 2,869.22 - 2,550.00 = 319.22 as printed. ONE FILER SLIP retained verbatim and not adjudicated: p7's 'Total Expenditures Received' line prints the CONTRIBUTIONS grand total (25,469.07) instead of 25,866.52 — crop-verified; p8 and p9 print the correct figure and the cover agrees with them. Also unusual on the cover: the 'Is this report an amendment?' Yes and No boxes are BOTH left unchecked (the 6/15 report checked No), so amendment status is not stated on the page and is not inferred here.
